title: feat(objectql): a single-valued nested-relation condition on a read verb is one in-database subquery, read-scoped, with no id cap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DWLrF6ZURGN6BVpSbuDyHTg)_

Part of #33626 — this PR lands the engine half (a single-valued relation, one hop, on read verbs); the hop extension, the dataset's own `filter` / per-measure filter doors, the up-front non-SQL refusal and the multi-valued form stay on the card (see Remaining).

Clause-②: yes (widening; narrowing on a related object another datasource holds, and on a driver that compiles no subquery)
Metadata-protocol: none

Area-lease pilot #33059, area A3.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：读操作（find/findOne/count/aggregate）里的单值关系条件 `{ account: { status: … } }` 不再先查父 id 再 `IN`，而是规划父对象的读并把最终 WHERE 作为 `ReadableIds` 子查询交给驱动，一条 SQL 完成，无 1000 上限。
- 为什么改：下游大数据量下「订单状态 ≠ 已取消」在一层就撞 1000 上限返回 400；维护者裁决 SQL 优先、最高性能方案。
- 风险与回滚：父对象的读权限必须完整进入子查询——由「规划读」走父对象的全部中间件/钩子/门禁保证，消融已证明去掉它会放行全部行；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/relation-semi-join.ts`（规划与防伪）、`engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts` 的 planned 分支、`engine-find.ts` 的 plan 出口。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/data-nested-relation-permission.test.ts`，预期 4 个用例全绿（含 `$ne` 下不可读父记录排除行）。
- 需要你做的：在 open question 里定内存驱动是否也要拒绝（卡片原文写拒绝，本 PR 让它进程内求值）。

## What changes

- **Planned related read.** For a single-valued relation condition on a read verb, `lowerRelationConditions` no longer reads the related ids. It runs the engine's own `find` on the related object as the caller, with an internal symbol-keyed option (`RELATION_SCOPE_PLAN`) that stops the read at its driver call and captures the final driver `where`. That `where` already holds the related object's CRUD gate verdict, every read middleware's scope (row-level security, the filter-oracle field check on the condition), `beforeFind` hooks, the comparand doors and its own composed `ReadableIds` leaves.
- **Semi-join leaf.** The site is replaced by `{ field: { $in: ReadableIds.of(target) } }`, and the leaf's identity is registered in a module-private `WeakMap` with the planned `where`. At the executor boundary `composeReadableIdsChain` composes that leaf with its planned scope instead of asking the security service (a parent only planned leaves name is not asked at all). `driver-sql` (every dialect) and Turso compile it to `field IN (SELECT id FROM target WHERE scope AND tenant wall)`; no id list, no cap. A caller-written `ReadableIds.of(P)` is a different object the map does not hold and composes as ADR-0139 says.
- **Fail-closed edges.** A planned read that never reached its driver call (a middleware answered without the driver) composes to `$in: []`. A related object on another datasource is refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 naming both datasources, before any read.
- **Unchanged.** A multi-valued relation and the write verbs (`update`, `delete`, whose `where` never reaches the composition boundary) keep the id read and its 1000 cap.
- Docs: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`, `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`; module docblocks in `relation-filter-lowering.ts` and `engine-query-lowering.ts`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-nested-relation-lowering.test.ts` — recording driver: one driver call per read (the related read is planned, never run), the semi-join leaf with the condition as its scope on every single-valued relation type and verb, composition inside `$and` / `$or` / `$not` / FilterArray, placeholders resolved before planning, the cap kept for multi-valued and for `update`.
- `packages/rest/src/data-nested-object-door.test.ts` (SQLite; PG/MySQL cells skipped without their env) — parity of the nested form with the two-step route, including NULL relation, `$not`, `$ne` and `$null` in the condition; the single-valued cap lifted (1001 matches served), the multi-valued cap kept.
- `packages/rest/src/data-nested-relation-permission.test.ts` (real `SecurityPlugin` + `SqlDriver`) — new case: a related record the caller's row scope hides satisfies `region != 'NA'` but its row is not selected (member: `d2`; system: `d2`, `d4`), through `find` and `count`.
- `packages/rest/src/analytics-nested-relation-filter.test.ts` — the single-valued past-cap row moved from refused to served on every analytics face.

## Acceptance notes

- `driver-memory` evaluates the composed leaf in process (ADR-0139 D3), so on memory the form is served with no cap. The card says memory refuses; this PR does not add a refusal there (open question).
- MongoDB / OData: the read reaches the driver and is refused with the existing ADR-0139 D3 driver refusal (`INTERNAL_ERROR` / 500). The card asks for a stable author-facing code ahead of the driver; ADR-0139 rules out a `DriverCapabilities` bit, so this needs a decision on how the engine learns it.
- A related object that an object-scoped read middleware narrows is still refused by ADR-0139 D5.2 wording at the boundary even though the planned read ran that middleware.
- `skills/objectstack-query` still teaches "up to 1000 related ids" for every relation (governed surface, not touched here).

## Remaining

- Hops: a condition beneath a related relation (ADR-0071's limit of 3) — admission still refuses `second-level`; the planned read would recurse naturally once admitted.
- Dataset own `filter` and per-measure filters (still refused per the merged one-hop PR).
- Up-front non-SQL refusal with a stable code; memory driver decision.
- Multi-valued relation as a JSON-membership semi-join.
- Full dogfood battery on the final head (the Clause-② line carries a narrowing arm); tests of every direct dependent of `@objectstack/objectql`.
